headline: 6 Michigan deals, $22.5M raised — led by Superior Frontier Capital Fund I, LP

top_deals.company: Superior Frontier Capital Fund I, LP
top_deals.summary: Superior Frontier Capital Fund I, LP, a Hancock-based investment fund, disclosed a $20M raise; $0 sold.
Heat2Power Inc., an Ann Arbor-based technology company, filed a $17.8M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $15.2M sold to 3 investors.
Mount Mfg, Inc., a Marquette-based manufacturing company, filed a $5.4M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $5.4M sold to 4 investors.
Top This Media, LLC, a Birmingham-based company, filed a $1.5M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $100K sold to 1 investor.
Noble Gas Systems Inc., a Novi-based manufacturing company, filed a $1.5M debt and options/warrants offering under Rule 506(b); $1.5M sold to 3 investors.

new_funds.company: Superior Frontier Capital Fund I, LP
new_funds.summary: Superior Frontier Capital Fund I, LP, a Hancock-based investment fund, disclosed a $20M raise; $0 sold.

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $22.5M sold across 6 Form D filings this week, down 37% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Heat2Power Inc. (Ann Arbor, Other Technology) targeting $17.8M. Good question to ask: are founders in technology favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

1 Michigan-based pooled fund filed Form Ds, reporting $0 raised so far — led by Superior Frontier Capital Fund I, LP (Other Investment Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
Manufacturing & Automotive was the most active sector with 2 of 6 filings (33%). Ask contacts what's driving the activity, and whether it's showing up in their pipeline.
